title: The Forge-Master's Ghost
text: The ghost of the forge-master walks the halls, hands clasped behind his back, inspecting, the way he did every morning of his life. He frowns at dust. He frowns at rust. He stops in front of the one with the heaviest gear, and he looks them up and down.

options.label: The one in the heaviest gear stands for inspection.

outcomes.text: He approves, and reforges a piece.
He nods and walks on, and as he passes he runs a cold thumb over every buckle and rivet you wear. They are tighter after.

options.label: Tell him the forge is dead.

outcomes.text: He does not take it well.
